text:
elen_fin: Alert: VectorBridge (acct VB-9004) showing $38,750 past due across 2 invoices. Oldest 52 days. Collections flagged client says their treasury team locked payments due to an internal audit and wants to pay via a different ACH. They're disputing a $1,950 usage line on INV-20240628 and have threatened to escalate legally if we pursue third-party collections. @toby_support @kevin_sales can you triage?

billing-bot: System note: invoices: INV-20240628 ($19,350), INV-20240518 ($19,400). Last payment: $0 in 2024. Status: PAST_DUE. Collections vendor: Northshore Collections outreach started 2024-08-20.

sam_collections: They've been stonewalling calls. Recommend short hold while finance engages; otherwise resume dunning. Need firm commitment timeline.

toby_support: I can provide a 45-minute portal unlock for ACH entry after we verify bank docs. Workflow: create ticket, run fraud checks, then run `/unlock-portal --acct=VB-9004 --minutes=45 --by=toby_support`. Uploads must go to secure intake: https://vault.redwood/payments-upload. No DMs.

kevin_sales: Suggest offering a one-time waiver on the disputed $1,950 to avoid counsel escalation, plus a payment schedule: 60% now, 40% in 30 days. I'll handle comms if finance approves.

elen_fin: Policy: provisional credits up to $2,000 can be done by finance ops; above that needs CFO sign-off. We can mark the $1,950 as 'disputed' in GL. But the portal unlock requires KYC docs + risk approval.

marisol_cfo: Approve provisional credit of $1,950 to de-escalate, conditional: 1) client uploads bank letter + voided check OR completes micro-deposit confirmation within the 45-minute window; 2) client signs a 14-day reconciliation agreement; 3) collections pause until 2024-08-28 COB. Add account note: "PROV_CREDIT_1950_MARISOL_2024-08-21". No multi-month deferrals without CFO sign-off.

toby_support: Creating ticket SB-92377 now and will run fraud checks. Will attach logs and wait for docs.

kevin_sales: I'll email the client now with the offer and request they upload docs to the intake link. CC collections & finance.

sam_collections: Pausing outreach until 2024-08-28 COB. If no signed ack/payment by then, we'll resume escalation on 2024-08-29.

elen_fin: I'll prepare the provisional credit entry and hold AR adjustments until we get signed ack. Will update SB-92377 after we receive docs.

kevin_sales: Client says treasury is tied up but they'll try to upload within the hour. I'll push for the 45m unlock window. :pray:
